purpose: Connect each material statement, event and legal-effect element in a property legal-life narrative to its supporting evidence, legal authority, dates, property match and limitations.
core_principle: NARRATIVE CLAIM → EVIDENCE → PROPERTY/DATE MATCH → LAW → EFFECT → LIMITATION
rules: Every material public narrative claim must have a traceable supporting reference.
Property-specific claims require property-specific evidence and property matching.
Historical claims require date matching and applicable historical legal version where legal effect is stated.
A claim may have multiple supporting records and legal sources.
A limitation must be shown when supporting evidence is incomplete or restricted.
The drill-down explains the basis of a claim but must not expose internal chain-of-thought or restricted material.
Citation references must identify the source sufficiently for the citizen to understand and, where available, retrieve the official source.
hard_stops: Never create a citation merely because a source is related to the topic.
Never use a general service page as proof of a property-specific fact.
Never hide missing evidence behind a generic source label.
Never expose restricted documents or unnecessary personal data.
Never present a legal proposition without its relevant authority and temporal scope.
